source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: As the first battle round begins, choose one unit in your opponent's army as this model's victim. Wound rolls for any attack this model makes against its victim may be re-rolled. Whenever its victim is destroyed, choose another enemy unit to become the new victim.
